meta.name: documentation-writer
meta.description: Write or update technical documentation for code, APIs, or systems. Use when asked to document a module, write a README, generate API docs, or update existing documentation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为代码或API编写清晰的技术文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为代码或API编写或更新技术文档
copy.tagline_en: Write clear technical documentation for code or APIs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write or update technical documentation for code or APIs

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude会先读取你的代码，然后生成或更新技术文档。它会为项目写README、为函数或类写文档注释，包含参数、返回值和使用示例，并确保文档与代码完全一致。
howto.when: 当你要求为代码模块写文档、写README、生成API文档或更新现有文档时，Claude会自动接管。

say.note: Claude会读取模块代码，生成完整的README文件。
Claude会分析函数签名并输出带示例的文档注释。

say.text: 更新这个API的文档，加一个新的示例
say.note: Claude会对比代码修改，补充缺失的例子。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to read your code, then generate or update technical documentation. It writes READMEs for projects, docstrings for functions/classes with parameters, return values, and usage examples, and ensures every claim is verified against the actual code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to document a module, write a README, generate API docs, or update existing documentation. Claude takes over to produce accurate docs.

say_en.text: Write a README for this Python module.
say_en.note: Claude reads the module and produces a full README.

say_en.text: Generate API docs for this function.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the function signature and outputs a docstring with examples.

say_en.text: Update this API doc to include a new example.
say_en.note: Claude cross-checks the code and adds the missing example.
